title: Ridgeline Home Improvement Financing Collections Guidance: Catch-Up Figure and Arrears
content:
**Guidance.** How the catch-up figure on a Ridgeline Home Improvement Financing account whose plan carries no promotion (a fixed-rate or low-payment plan) is worked out depends on the arrears: an account two or more scheduled payments behind pays the unpaid part of the scheduled payments that have fallen due, being the scheduled monthly payment times the statement periods fallen due less the scheduled-payment money already paid net of returned payments, plus the fee pool; an account exactly one payment behind and enrolled in autopay pays the fee pool alone, leaving the next draw to collect the payment behind; every other account pays the balance on the account less the scheduled balance after the scheduled payments already covered plus one, but never beyond the scheduled payments that have fallen due. An account paid ahead of its schedule counts as no scheduled payments behind.

## Terms

- **Statement periods fallen due**: the statement periods carrying a monthly-interest entry, less the months deferred under hardship deferrals.
- **Scheduled payments behind**: the statement periods fallen due minus the payments covered — the scheduled-payment entries less the returned payments, divided by the scheduled monthly payment and rounded down to a whole number; an account paid ahead of its schedule, where the payments covered exceed the periods fallen due, counts as none behind.
- **Scheduled-payment money paid net of returned payments**: the money of the scheduled-payment entries less the money of the returned payments. Where it already reaches the scheduled payments fallen due, the unpaid part is zero.
- **Fee pool**: the late fees, returned-payment fees and phone payment fees posted in the three months before the payment, less the fee reversals posted in those months (a pool below zero counts as zero).

## Figure by arrears

| Scheduled payments behind | Autopay enrolled | Catch-up figure |
|---|---|---|
| 2 or more | Either | Unpaid part of the scheduled payments fallen due, plus the fee pool |
| Exactly 1 | Yes | The fee pool alone |
| Exactly 1 | No | Balance on the account less the scheduled balance after the payments covered plus one |
| None | Either | Balance on the account less the scheduled balance after the payments covered plus one |

## Hypothetical case (two or more behind)

Scheduled monthly payment 250.00; 10 statement periods fallen due; scheduled-payment money paid net of returns 1950.00, so 7 payments covered and 3 behind; fee pool 70.00. Unpaid part: 250.00 times 10 is 2500.00, less 1950.00, 550.00; the figure is 550.00 plus 70.00, 620.00.

## Hypothetical case (one behind, autopay)

Fee pool 39.00, one payment behind, autopay enrolled: the figure is 39.00, and the next autopay draw collects the payment behind.
